items.prompt: Bids rest at 1000 and 1005 cents. Which level does a market SELL consume first?

options.text: The ask side at its lowest price.
options.why: A seller trades against buying interest, not another ask.

options.text: Bid 1000, because earlier/lower numeric price always wins.
options.why: A market SELL receives the highest available bid first.

options.text: An average price halfway between the bids.
options.why: The task trades at resting levels, not an invented midpoint.
Price priority outranks time at a worse bid.

items.explanation: Price priority outranks time at a worse bid.
